articles.zh: 微塑料正在伤害我们吗？
body: Scientists are finding tiny pieces of plastic, called microplastics, in seafood and even inside our bodies.
科学家们在海鲜甚至我们的身体里，都发现了被称为“微塑料”的微小塑料颗粒。
A professor explained that new evidence shows a link between plastic particles and animal tissue, though the long-term effects on human health are still unclear.
一位教授解释说，新证据显示塑料颗粒与动物组织之间存在关联，不过对人体健康的长期影响仍不明确。
The good news: the famous 'credit card of plastic a week' claim is a myth — it would actually take thousands of years to eat that much.
好消息是：流传很广的“每周吃下一张信用卡大小的塑料”其实是谣传——真要吃到那个量，得花上千年。
tips: 微塑料，肉眼看不见的小塑料颗粒
关联性，两个事物之间的联系

articles.zh: 向不同年龄段的人学习
body: Could spending time with people from other age groups make us healthier? Some projects now pair nurseries with retirement homes.
和其他年龄段的人相处，能让我们更健康吗？现在有一些项目把幼儿园和养老院结对。
Research suggests these mixed-age meet-ups can reduce loneliness for older people and build confidence in young children.
研究表明，这种跨代相处既能减少老人的孤独感，也能让小孩子更有自信。
You do not need a special project to try this: a call to a grandparent counts too.
不需要专门的项目也能试一试：给家里长辈打个电话，也算数。
tips: 跨年龄段的、不同年龄混合的
纽带，人与人之间的亲密联系

body: Vaccines are not only for travel and childhood illnesses any more. Scientists are designing personalised vaccines that train the immune system to fight certain cancers.
疫苗不再只用于出国旅行和儿童疾病。科学家正在设计“个性化疫苗”，训练免疫系统去对抗某些癌症。
The idea is simple: teach the body to recognise cancer cells early, before a tumour can grow.
思路很简单：在肿瘤长大之前，先教会身体尽早识别癌细胞。
The research is still new, but it shows how fast medicine is moving when it teams up with AI-style data analysis.
这项研究还很新，但它让我们看到：医学一旦和AI式的数据分析联手，前进速度有多惊人。

articles.en: What should you eat for a better night's sleep?
articles.zh: 晚餐吃什么，才能睡个好觉？
body: What you eat in the evening may decide how well you sleep. Heavy, sugary meals late at night can break your sleep into small pieces.
晚上吃什么，可能决定你睡得好不好。深夜吃太多高糖重口的食物，会把睡眠切得七零八落。
Foods with magnesium and tryptophan, like nuts, milk and bananas, may help the body relax before bed.
含镁和色氨酸的食物，比如坚果、牛奶和香蕉，可能帮助身体在睡前放松下来。
The best habit costs nothing: finish big meals two to three hours before bed.
最好的习惯一分钱不花：大餐要在睡前两三个小时吃完。
tips: 镁，一种帮助放松的矿物质
色氨酸，和睡眠相关的氨基酸
放松下来，让身体进入睡前状态

body: Gold has reached very high prices, and many people now ask whether they should buy some too.
金价已经涨到很高的位置，很多人开始问：自己是不是也该买点黄金。
Fans of gold say it keeps its value when money loses power; others warn that buying at a peak can be risky.
支持者说，货币贬值时黄金能保值；也有人提醒，在最高点买入风险很大。
The lesson from history: gold is a long-term store of value, not a way to get rich quickly.
历史的教训是：黄金是长期的价值储藏工具，不是快速致富的捷径。
tips: 价值储藏，把钱放进不容易贬值的资产
波动大的、价格忽上忽下的
